metadata.description: Claude Code skills from Alex Tong's YouTube videos. One plugin per video.

plugins.name: claude-md-audit
plugins.description: Scores every CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules file in a repo out of 11 and names the exact lines to cut. Read-only during the audit.

plugins.name: fresh
plugins.description: The restart for when context is running low, polluted, or the session went sideways: writes a short resume prompt from the conversation and live git state and puts it on your clipboard; you type /clear and paste it. Writes one file under ~/.claude/fresh/ and nothing else.

plugins.name: skill-banner
plugins.description: Prints a RUNNING SKILL banner with the skill's name the moment a skill starts — the one you typed, or the one Claude picked on its own. Two hooks, one script, writes nothing.
